projects.name: Inventory & Stock Management
projects.description: Role-based inventory workflow with product, stock, supplier, and reporting modules.
projects.overview: A practical inventory system built for day-to-day stock control. Admins and staff can manage products, track stock movement, handle suppliers, and generate useful reports without messy spreadsheets.
features: Role-based access for admin and staff users
Product create, update, and category management
Stock in / stock out tracking with history
projects.challenges: Kept stock updates consistent across modules and made role permissions clear so staff only see what they need.

projects.name: Payment Gateway Integration
projects.description: Secure checkout integration with transaction handling, validation, and admin visibility.
projects.overview: Backend payment flow that connects checkout requests to a payment gateway, validates responses, stores transaction status, and gives admins a clear view of successful and failed payments.
features: Secure checkout request and callback handling
REST API endpoints for frontend checkout
projects.challenges: Focused on reliable callback handling and clear transaction states so money movement stays auditable.

projects.name: Responsive Business Website
projects.description: Mobile-first website with clean sections, reusable UI blocks, and browser-compatible styling.
projects.overview: A responsive business website designed mobile-first. Clean section layout, reusable UI pieces, and consistent styling across modern browsers.
projects.challenges: Balanced visual polish with simple reusable components so the site stays fast and easy to extend.
